entry.en: A passport must have an expiry date at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe caducar al menos 3 meses después del día en que planeas salir del espacio Schengen.
entry.quote: have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area

entry.en: At Austrian border control you may need to show proof of accommodation.
entry.es: En el control fronterizo austriaco puede que tengas que mostrar comprobante de alojamiento.
entry.quote: show proof of your accommodation, for example, a hotel booking confirmation or proof of address for a second home

entry.en: At Austrian border control you may need to show a return or onward ticket.
entry.es: En el control fronterizo austriaco puede que tengas que mostrar un billete de vuelta o de continuación.
entry.quote: show a return or onward ticket

entry.en: Cash or travellers cheques worth 10,000 euros or more must be declared when entering Austria.
entry.es: Hay que declarar el efectivo o los cheques de viaje por valor de 10.000 euros o más al entrar en Austria.
entry.quote: Declare cash or travellers cheques if the value is 10,000 euros or more.

entry.en: Meat, milk or products containing them cannot be taken into EU countries, with some exceptions.
entry.es: No se puede llevar carne, leche ni productos que los contengan a países de la UE, con algunas excepciones.
entry.quote: You cannot take meat, milk or products containing them into EU countries.

entry.en: Under the EU Entry/Exit System, short-stay visitors may need to register biometric details such as fingerprints and a photo.
entry.es: Con el Sistema de Entradas y Salidas de la UE, los visitantes de estancia corta pueden tener que registrar datos biométricos como huellas y foto.
entry.quote: you may need to register your biometric details, such as fingerprints and a photo.

safety.en: Crime is generally low, but petty crime such as pickpocketing is higher in big city centres and city parks after dark.
safety.es: La delincuencia es generalmente baja, pero hay más hurtos, sobre todo carteristas, en los centros de grandes ciudades y parques urbanos tras el anochecer.
safety.quote: there are higher levels of petty crime, particularly pickpocketing, in the big city centres and city parks after dark.

safety.en: Terrorists are likely to try to carry out attacks in Austria.
safety.es: Es probable que los terroristas intenten cometer atentados en Austria.
safety.quote: Terrorists are likely to try to carry out attacks in Austria.

safety.en: Illegal drugs, including cannabis, carry severe penalties in Austria.
safety.es: Las drogas ilegales, incluido el cannabis, conllevan penas severas en Austria.
safety.quote: Illegal drugs, including cannabis, carry severe penalties.

safety.en: It is generally illegal to wear clothing or objects in public that cover your face, with a fine of up to 150 euros.
safety.es: Por lo general es ilegal llevar en público prendas u objetos que cubran el rostro, con multa de hasta 150 euros.
safety.quote: It’s generally illegal to wear any clothing or object in public that covers your face. You could get a fine of up to 150 euros.

safety.en: You must validate your ticket in a machine before a public transport journey or risk an on-the-spot fine of 100 to 500 euros.
safety.es: Debes validar el billete en una máquina antes de viajar en transporte público o te arriesgas a una multa inmediata de 100 a 500 euros.
safety.quote: You must validate your ticket in a ticket machine before starting a journey on public transport. If you do not, you could get a 100 to 500 euro on-the-spot fine.

safety.en: Off-piste skiing is very dangerous and can invalidate your travel insurance.
safety.es: Esquiar fuera de pista es muy peligroso y puede invalidar tu seguro de viaje.
safety.quote: Off-piste skiing is very dangerous and can invalidate your travel insurance.

health.en: Dial 112 and ask for an ambulance for a medical emergency.
health.es: Marca el 112 y pide una ambulancia en caso de emergencia médica.
health.quote: Dial 112 and ask for an ambulance.

health.en: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Austria.
health.es: El mal de altura es un riesgo en algunas zonas de Austria.
health.quote: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Austria.

health.en: Mountain rescue by helicopter is not covered by an EHIC or most travel insurance and can be billed at upwards of €1000.
health.es: El rescate en montaña en helicóptero no lo cubre la EHIC ni la mayoría de seguros de viaje y puede facturarse a partir de 1000 €.
health.quote: Beware: Mountain rescue by helicopter is not covered by your EHIC, or indeed most travel insurance.

health.en: Certain regions of Austria (Carinthia, Styria, Lower Austria) are affected by tick-borne encephalitis.
health.es: Algunas regiones de Austria (Carintia, Estiria, Baja Austria) están afectadas por la encefalitis transmitida por garrapatas.
health.quote: Certain regions in Austria (Carinthia, Styria, Lower Austria) are affected by tick borne encephalitis.

health.en: Tap water is described as of exceptional quality and safe to drink, except in some parts of Lower Austria where asking first is recommended.
health.es: Se describe el agua del grifo como de calidad excepcional y segura, salvo en algunas zonas de Baja Austria donde se recomienda preguntar antes.
health.quote: Tap water is of exceptional quality and safe to drink in Austria (except in some parts of lower Austria, where it is recommended to ask about the water quality first!).

health.en: Non-EU travellers without travel insurance must pay the full cost of treatment up-front, except in the emergency room.
health.es: Los viajeros de fuera de la UE sin seguro deben pagar por adelantado todo el tratamiento, salvo en urgencias.
health.quote: you will need to pay the full cost of treatment up-front (with the exception of the emergency room)

help.en: Austrian emergency numbers are 144 for ambulance or rescue, 122 for fire and 133 for police.
help.es: Los números de emergencia de Austria son el 144 para ambulancia o rescate, el 122 para bomberos y el 133 para policía.

help.en: The European emergency number 112 also works in Austria.
help.es: El número europeo de emergencias 112 también funciona en Austria.

getting_in.en: Vienna Airport is the most important international airport in Austria.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto de Viena es el aeropuerto internacional más importante de Austria.
getting_in.quote: The most important international airport is Vienna Airport (VIE IATA)

getting_in.en: Austria has six airports with scheduled flights.
getting_in.es: Austria tiene seis aeropuertos con vuelos regulares.
getting_in.quote: There are six airports in Austria with scheduled flights.

getting_in.en: Temporary border checks by Austrian Police apply as of 2026 for travellers entering via Slovenia and sometimes Hungary.
getting_in.es: En 2026 se aplican controles fronterizos temporales de la policía austriaca a quienes entran desde Eslovenia y a veces Hungría.
getting_in.quote: As of 2026, travellers entering via Slovenia (and sometimes Hungary) are subjected to border checks by the Austrian Police.

getting_in.en: Every neighbouring country has trains to and from Austria at least hourly.
getting_in.es: Todos los países vecinos tienen trenes desde y hacia Austria al menos cada hora.
getting_in.quote: Every neighbouring country (yes, even Liechtenstein) has trains to and from Austria at least hourly.

getting_in.en: Driving on Austrian motorways requires a vignette, digital or a physical sticker on the windscreen.
getting_in.es: Para circular por autopistas austriacas hace falta una viñeta, digital o un adhesivo físico en el parabrisas.
getting_in.quote: For using the Autobahnen or Schnellstraßen, a vignette, or tax sticker, must be purchased.

getting_around.en: Trains are the best and most common form of mass transport in Austria.
getting_around.es: Los trenes son el medio de transporte masivo mejor y más común de Austria.
getting_around.quote: Trains are the best and most common form of mass transport in Austria.

getting_around.en: Between Vienna, Linz and Salzburg trains run every 30 minutes or more frequently.
getting_around.es: Entre Viena, Linz y Salzburgo los trenes circulan cada 30 minutos o con más frecuencia.
getting_around.quote: Between Vienna, Linz, and Salzburg trains run every 30 minutes or even more frequently.

getting_around.en: On long-distance trains you can buy tickets from the conductor, but the price is much higher.
getting_around.es: En los trenes de larga distancia se puede comprar el billete al revisor, pero el precio es mucho mayor.
getting_around.quote: you can also buy tickets from the conductor on board, but the price is much higher.

getting_around.en: Speed limits are 130 km/h on Autobahnen and 100 km/h on Schnellstraßen and Bundesstraßen, and headlights should be on at all times.
getting_around.es: Los límites son 130 km/h en autopistas y 100 km/h en Schnellstraßen y Bundesstraßen, y las luces deben ir siempre encendidas.
getting_around.quote: The speed limits are 130 km/h (81 mph) on Autobahnen and 100 km/h (62 mph) on Schnellstraßen and Bundesstraßen.

getting_around.en: Winter tires are mandatory between November 1 and April 15.
getting_around.es: Los neumáticos de invierno son obligatorios entre el 1 de noviembre y el 15 de abril.
getting_around.quote: Winter tires are mandatory between November 1 and April 15.

getting_around.en: As of 2024, the most popular ride-hailing services in Austria are Uber, Bolt and Free Now.
getting_around.es: En 2024, los servicios de transporte con conductor más populares en Austria son Uber, Bolt y Free Now.
getting_around.quote: As of 2024, the most popular ride-hailing services in Austria are Uber, Bolt and Free Now.

money.quote: Austria uses the euro, like several other European countries.

money.en: Austria is a cash-oriented society and many shops are still cash only, though card acceptance is rising.
money.es: Austria es una sociedad que usa mucho el efectivo y muchas tiendas solo aceptan efectivo, aunque aumenta el uso de tarjetas.
money.quote: Austria is a cash-oriented society, and while acceptance of credit/debit cards is on the rise, many shops are still cash only.

money.en: ATMs, called Bankomat, are widespread and the majority accept foreign cards.
money.es: Los cajeros, llamados Bankomat, son abundantes y la mayoría acepta tarjetas extranjeras.
money.quote: ATMs in Austria are called Bankomat. They are widespread and you will find them even in smaller, rural villages.

money.en: Tipping of 5% to 10% is common and often considered socially obligatory, though not legally mandatory.
money.es: La propina del 5% al 10% es habitual y a menudo se considera socialmente obligatoria, aunque no lo es legalmente.
money.quote: In Austria, tipping is common and, although legally not mandatory, often considered as socially obligatory. Giving 5% to 10% of the total amount is common

money.en: Bargaining is not common in Austria except at flea markets.
money.es: Regatear no es habitual en Austria salvo en los mercadillos.
money.quote: Bargaining is not common throughout Austria except at flea markets.

money.en: The general sales tax of 20% is included in prices.
money.es: El impuesto general sobre las ventas, del 20%, está incluido en los precios.
money.quote: The general sales tax of 20% is included in prices

etiquette.en: Austrians say hello and goodbye when entering and leaving public places, formally with Grüß Gott and Auf Wiedersehen.
etiquette.es: Los austriacos saludan y se despiden al entrar y salir de lugares públicos, formalmente con Grüß Gott y Auf Wiedersehen.
etiquette.quote: When entering and leaving public places Austrians always say hello (Grüß Gott as formal greeting and a normal Hallo as a semi-formal greeting) and goodbye (Auf Wiedersehen).

etiquette.en: Shouting, raising your voice or losing your temper in public is highly frowned upon.
etiquette.es: Levantar la voz, perder los nervios o gritar en público está muy mal visto.
etiquette.quote: Do not raise your voice, lose your temper, or shout in public; in Austria this is highly frowned upon.

etiquette.en: When introduced to someone, shake hands and make eye contact.
etiquette.es: Al ser presentado, se da la mano y se mantiene el contacto visual.
etiquette.quote: When being introduced to someone, always shake them by the hand, keep the other hand out of your pocket, say your name and make eye contact.

etiquette.en: Calling Austrians Germans is incorrect and may cause offense.
etiquette.es: Llamar alemanes a los austriacos es incorrecto y puede ofender.
etiquette.quote: Austrians are their own people; referring to them as "Germans" is incorrect and may cause offense.

etiquette.en: In most Austrian households it is customary to take off one's shoes.
etiquette.es: En la mayoría de los hogares austriacos es costumbre quitarse los zapatos.
etiquette.quote: In most Austrian households it is customary to take off one's shoes.

etiquette.en: Since 2019 there is a complete smoking ban in restaurants, bars, cafés and hotels.
etiquette.es: Desde 2019 hay una prohibición total de fumar en restaurantes, bares, cafés y hoteles.
etiquette.quote: Since 2019, there is a complete smoking ban in gastronomy (restaurants, bars, cafés, etc.) as well as hotels

connectivity.en: Austria has three network operators: A1, Magenta and Drei.
connectivity.es: Austria tiene tres operadores de red: A1, Magenta y Drei.
connectivity.quote: Austria has three network operators: A1, Magenta and Drei.

connectivity.en: Several providers offer pay-as-you-go plans open to non-residents that do not require registration.
connectivity.es: Varios proveedores ofrecen planes de prepago abiertos a no residentes que no requieren registro.
connectivity.quote: Several providers offer pay-as-you-go plans that are open to non-residents, don't require registration

connectivity.en: There is free WiFi at most trains and railway stations.
connectivity.es: Hay wifi gratuito en la mayoría de los trenes y estaciones.
connectivity.quote: there is also free WiFi at most of the trains and railway stations.

connectivity.en: Some remote mountainous areas have no network coverage.
connectivity.es: Algunas zonas remotas de montaña no tienen cobertura.
connectivity.quote: some remote areas (especially mountainous areas) do not have network coverage
